# MIT Sloan Management Review

> A premier business research and management publication from MIT featuring cutting-edge insights on leadership, AI, digital transformation, and organizational strategy.

MIT Sloan Management Review is a peer-reviewed business journal and digital platform that publishes research-backed articles and case studies on contemporary management challenges. The publication covers emerging trends in AI, leadership development, talent management, and enterprise transformation, drawing on research from MIT faculty and global thought leaders.

## Key Topics

- AI and Machine Learning
- Digital Transformation
- Leadership Development
- Business Strategy
- Organizational Culture
- Talent Management
- Enterprise Innovation
- Case Studies
- HR Practices
- Management Research
- Leadership Trends
- Technology Strategy

## Core Navigation

- [MIT Sloan Management Review](https://sloanreview.mit.edu): Homepage featuring management ideas and research from MIT Sloan
- [All Topics](https://sloanreview.mit.edu/all-topics): Topic directory and taxonomy of MIT Sloan Review business content
- [Most Popular](https://sloanreview.mit.edu/most-popular): Most popular articles on AI trends, talent, leadership, and digital transformation

## Research & Big Ideas

- [Big Ideas](https://sloanreview.mit.edu/big-ideas): MIT Sloan big ideas research hub on AI, enterprise strategy, and innovation
- [Future of Leadership](https://sloanreview.mit.edu/big-ideas/future-of-leadership): Research on digital leadership featuring Cognizant survey and thought leaders
